text:
morgan_cs: Quick check on Tidecrest onboarding — they report 95p tail ~2.0s and token spend ~1.5x forecast. Renewal in ~8 weeks. Thinking a small pilot: int8 canary + routing by token-length + KV cache. ok?

ali_se: +1. They care about perceived speed. Suggest 2% canary to int8 for short requests and a small-model for <180 tokens. fallback to fp16 for long contexts.

tara_ml: ran 60-sample eval. int8-lite median cosine 0.985. Most diffs are formatting. Recommend 48h A/B with semantic gate at 0.98.

kevin_ops: infra: tenant on shared-us-west. I can provision canary nodes and enable prefix KV cache. ops-bot, create alerts for semantic < 0.98 (20m) and 95p > 1700ms (15m).

# canary snippet (ali_se):
```
route: "tidecrest-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: tokens(input) < 180 and rand() < 0.02
    target: redwood-int8-lite
  - condition: tokens(input) >= 180
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_semantic_cosine_lt: 0.98
    action: route_to redwood-fp16-stable
```

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-tidecrest-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.98 (20m), 95p_latency > 1700ms (15m). owner: kevin_ops.

morgan_cs: Timeline: start canary Mon 09:00 PT for 48h, quick sync Tue EOD. I'll email the customer with one-question pulse after pilot. Thanks team :thumbsup:
